summary.state: 情绪暂稳但未修复：美股小幅续跌、上涨家数约 40%；油价因美国释放战略储备和海湾外运恢复大跌约 4%，但 30 年期美债升至 2002 年以来最高、消费者信心降至 12 年低点——环境压力转为混合。
summary.state_en: Stable but not repaired: US stocks slip again with ~40% advancing; oil falls ~4% on a US reserve release and recovering Gulf flows, but the 30-year hits its highest since 2002 and consumer confidence a 12-year low — macro pressure turns mixed.

changed.why_en: One regulatory decision can reset pricing power overnight — a fundamental change, not sentiment.

changed.what_en: Consumer confidence at a 12-year low; the 30-year highest since 2002.

changed.why_en: Weaker spending with sticky inflation makes the Fed's choice harder and can keep pressure on long rates.

FICO.headline: FHFA：房利美、房地美按揭定价纳入竞品 VantageScore，FICO 按揭评分垄断受冲击
FICO.headline_en: FHFA: Fannie and Freddie to price mortgages with rival VantageScore, threatening FICO's mortgage-scoring monopoly

points.text: FHFA 负责人 Bill Pulte 宣布，房利美和房地美将采用统一的按揭定价模型，并纳入与 FICO 直接竞争的 VantageScore 数据；同时 TransUnion 把 VantageScore 4.0 的按揭定价延长到 2028 年 12 月。
points.text_en: FHFA head Bill Pulte announced Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac will adopt a unified mortgage-pricing model incorporating rival VantageScore; TransUnion extended VantageScore 4.0 mortgage pricing to December 2028.

points.text: 按揭评分是 FICO 利润最高的业务之一，这次是监管层面的竞争格局改变，而不是一季度业绩波动；单日下跌 26.5%、量比 10.9 倍，说明市场在重新评估长期定价权。
points.text_en: Mortgage scoring is among FICO's most profitable lines; this is a regulatory change in competition, not a quarterly wobble. A 26.5% drop on 10.9x volume reflects a reset of long-term pricing power.

CCL.headline: 三季度业绩创纪录，上调全年 EPS 指引

points.text_en: Carnival's 9/29 8-K: record adjusted EPS of $1.43 and revenue of $8.43bn; full-year adjusted EPS guide raised to $2.24; Q3 customer deposits up ~7% YoY and 2027 booked occupancy and pricing at records.

VSVS.L.headline: 确认收到 RHI Magnesita 现金加股票收购提议，报价较前收溢价约 47%
VSVS.L.headline_en: Confirms a cash-and-shares proposal from RHI Magnesita at a ~47% premium

points.text: Vesuvius 确认自 2025 年 9 月以来多次收到 RHI Magnesita 主动提出的收购提议；最新方案为每股 470 便士现金加每 10 股换 0.28 股新 RHI 股，按 RHI 一个月成交均价计约合每股 551 便士，较 9/28 收盘溢价约 47%。董事会正在与顾问评估，此前已拒绝 448 便士的现金报价。
points.text_en: Vesuvius confirmed repeated unsolicited approaches from RHI Magnesita since September 2025; the latest is 470p cash plus 0.28 new RHI shares per 10 Vesuvius shares, ~551p per share on RHI's one-month VWAP — a ~47% premium to the 9/28 close. The board is evaluating it and had rejected a 448p cash offer.

points.text: 研究解读：收盘价 467 便士明显低于约 551 便士的隐含报价，差距反映了董事会可能再次拒绝、以及股票对价随 RHI 股价波动的风险。不构成个体化行动建议。
points.text_en: Research reading: the 467p close sits well below the ~551p implied value, reflecting the risk the board rejects again and that the share component moves with RHI's price. Not individual advice.

CBG.L.headline: 年度业绩：成本节约大幅超出目标，资本充足率上升；不派末期股息
CBG.L.headline_en: Full-year results: cost savings well ahead of target, capital up; no final dividend

points.text: 截至 7 月底的年度成本节约约 3600 万英镑，远超约 2500 万英镑的目标，预计 2027 财年末超过 6000 万英镑；CET1 升至 14.1%。调整后经营利润下降 17% 至 1.203 亿英镑，并因汽车金融赔偿方案的不确定性不派末期股息。
points.text_en: Annualised cost savings of ~£36m to end-July, well ahead of a ~£25m target, expected to exceed £60m by end-FY27; CET1 rose to 14.1%. Adjusted operating profit fell 17% to £120.3m and no final dividend was declared given motor-finance redress uncertainty.

items.claim: （9/25）Harworth 交割后，股价是否维持在 187 便士 ±1% 以内？
items.claim_en: (9/25) Will Harworth hold within ±1% of 187p after settlement?
items.outcome: 9/29 交割日收于 187.0 便士，与报价相同，在区间内。
items.outcome_en: Closed 187.0p on the 9/29 settlement date — at the offer price, inside the band.
items.lesson: 在"最终报价 + 收购方持股过半"的结构下，价格被牢牢锚定在报价上。
items.lesson_en: A best-and-final price plus a majority holder anchored the shares firmly.

items.claim: 10 年期站上 5.2% 后，黄金会否在周五前继续承压（10/2 收盘低于 4,154.7）？
items.claim_en: With the 10-year above 5.2%, will gold stay below 4,154.7 into Friday?
items.outcome: 9/29 黄金期货收于 4,215.0，比 9/28 上涨约 1.45%，而 10 年期仍在 5.26%。中途证据与预期相反；时限 10/2。
items.outcome_en: Gold futures closed 4,215.0 on 9/29, ~+1.45% vs 9/28, with the 10-year still at 5.26%. Interim evidence runs against the call; horizon 10/2.
items.lesson: 数据管线一度把 9/29 黄金算成 -2.46%（Yahoo 缺了 9/28 的 K 线，涨跌幅被跨日错算）。如果直接采用，会误判为"证据一致"。已更正，并新增"前一交易日 K 线必须存在"的检查。
items.lesson_en: The pipeline first computed gold at -2.46% on 9/29 (Yahoo dropped the 9/28 bar, so the change spanned two days). Taken at face value it would have looked 'consistent'. Corrected, and a 'previous-session bar must exist' check was added.

items.claim: 芯片抛售是一次性冲击吗（美股 CPO 在 10/5 前收复 9/25 水平）？
items.claim_en: Is the chip selloff a one-off (US CPO back to its 9/25 level by 10/5)?
items.outcome: 9/29 美股 CPO 11 只反弹，相对 9/25 收盘等权 -0.31%，接近收复。
items.outcome_en: The 11 US CPO names rebounded on 9/29, -0.31% EW versus the 9/25 close — nearly recovered.
items.lesson: 修复速度快于预期；时限 10/5。

items.claim: 英国首购计划的涨幅能否撑到预算前（10/9 仍高于 9/25 +8%）？

items.lesson: 分化出现：基本面最弱的 Vistry 最先回吐。
items.lesson_en: Dispersion emerging: the weakest balance sheet, Vistry, gave back first.
